description: Census of Canada. Skeletal Street Network Files, 1996 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Statistics Canada. The SSNFs have been produced solely to provide some cartographic reference features when producing thematic maps with the CT Digital Cartographic Files (DCFs). The SSNFs are provided for users who do not require the detail of the Street Network Files from which they were derived. Coverage: national (CA); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
